tools.name: get_macro_snapshot
tools.description: Start here for "how is the Polish economy doing" or a briefing. Returns the six headline indicators (GDP, inflation, unemployment, wages, rates and similar) with latest reading, change and freshness, which indicators changed recently, and the next releases and RPP meetings.

tools.name: list_macro_indicators
tools.description: Find indicators and their keys. Latest reading, change, next release and source for GDP, CPI and core inflation, unemployment, wages, retail sales, industrial output, NBP rates, FX, consumer sentiment, mortgage market and statutory limits. Filter by group or free text (Polish or English words, e.g.

tools.name: get_macro_indicator
tools.description: One indicator by key with its meaning, latest reading, freshness, next release and history (oldest first) with min and max over the window. Use for "what is the current X", "how has X changed".

tools.name: compare_macro_indicators
tools.description: History of 2-4 indicators aligned by period, for questions like "are wages growing faster than prices". All keys must have the same frequency (all monthly, or all quarterly); otherwise the call fails and says which differ.

tools.name: get_macro_changes
tools.description: Indicators whose reading was updated in the last N days (newest first), with the change against the previous reading.

tools.name: get_macro_calendar
tools.description: Upcoming Polish macro releases and decisions (RPP rate decisions, CPI, wages, GDP, industrial output) with date, time and importance (higher is more important). Dates marked tentative may move.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Catalog of all finwire.pl datasets (rates, FX, gold, fuel and energy prices, Finwire Nowcast, broker fees, housing prices and rents, credit market, legal limits and law changes, regional income, Europe) with the best tool to call, its parameters, license and finwire.pl page. Use when no other tool o

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Any dataset by id from search_datasets, with optional params listed there. Returns the same data as the public REST API /v1 (long lists shortened). Prefer the dedicated tools when one fits.

tools.name: get_interest_rates
tools.description: Current NBP policy rates (reference, lombard, deposit, rediscount, discount) with the date of the last change, or the history of one rate. WIBOR and POLSTR are not available (GPW Benchmark license).

tools.name: get_currency_rates
tools.description: NBP mid, bid and ask rates of currencies against PLN (table), the history of one currency, or the NBP gold price (code "XAU").

tools.name: get_fuel_prices
tools.description: Maximum retail prices of Pb95, Pb98 and diesel in PLN per litre announced by the Minister of Energy in Monitor Polski: price in force, next day price if announced, and recent history.

tools.name: get_nowcast
tools.description: Finwire Nowcast, the finwire.pl statistical model of the next official readings: CPI inflation y/y and core inflation y/y (point and 80% interval) and probabilities of a cut, no change or hike at the next RPP (Monetary Policy Council) meeting. Recomputed daily, frozen 3 working days before publicati

tools.name: get_energy_prices
tools.description: Household electricity and gas tariffs approved by URE and in force today: electricity energy price of the default seller and distribution rates per operator for G11, G12 and G12w with cheaper-zone hours and fees; gas fuel price, subscription and PSG distribution rates per tariff area for W-1.1 to W-

tools.name: get_broker_fees
tools.description: Fees of brokers available to Polish investors from their official fee tables: online order commission on Warsaw (GPW), US and German stocks and ETFs, account and currency conversion fees, IKE/IKZE, investor protection and promotions valid today, with the fee table URL and the date it was last confir

tools.name: get_housing_prices
tools.description: Transaction prices of flats per square meter from notarial deeds (RCN): median, quartiles, year-over-year change and number of deeds in 17 cities, or per district of one city. source "gus" gives the GUS quarterly series instead.

tools.name: get_rents
tools.description: Asking rents (median, per m², month-over-month change) in Polish cities and districts, with gross and net rental yield and payback period.

tools.name: get_housing_costs
tools.description: Monthly running costs of a flat in 20 largest cities: co-op and owners association charges per m², heating, electricity, gas, water and waste rates, each with year and scope (city or province).

tools.name: get_credit_market
tools.description: Polish housing loan market: topic "index" (finwire 0-100 credit market index), "survey" (NBP bank lending survey: criteria and demand), "monetary" (NBP household loans and deposits, new housing loans).

tools.name: get_bank_rates
tools.description: Aggregates of offers currently on the market (median and percentiles, no single bank offers): mortgage APRC and margin, cash loan APRC, term deposit and savings account rates; or retail government bond rates (product "bonds").

tools.name: get_legal_limits
tools.description: Statutory values for the current year: IKE and IKZE contribution limits, PIT thresholds and rates, tax-free amount, capital gains tax, rental flat-rate tax, minimum wage and other limits; topic "local-tax" gives the upper limits of local property tax rates.

tools.name: get_legal_changes
tools.description: Acts of the Journal of Laws and Monitor Polski on personal finance, tax, labour and housing: entering into force soon and recently, with plain-language summaries, plus bills in the Sejm.

tools.name: get_regional_data
tools.description: Regional data: "income" (residents income per capita by municipality, or county with level "powiat"), "unemployment" (registered unemployment by province), "wages" (average wage by province). Filter by name.

tools.name: get_europe_data
tools.description: Poland compared with EU countries: "house-prices" (Eurostat house price index), "mortgage-rates" (ECB rates on new housing loans), "bond-yields" (10-year yields and spreads vs Germany and euro area), "overburden" and "overcrowding" (housing conditions).
